title: Three-face CNC work origin touch block
engineering: Adding explicit side-stylus compensation cuts worst modeled XYZ origin error from 1.528 mm to 0.029 mm across three stock setups.
physical_check: Measure each face, verify isolation and wiring continuity with a meter, and log repeatability across three independently loaded stock coupons. Establish machine input compatibility, coordinate polarity and probe recovery separately.

title: Fixed-height CNC tool setter puck
engineering: Increasing nominal spring travel from 1.35 to 2.05 mm gives the delayed-stop model 0.54 mm of remaining stroke.
physical_check: Measure spring rate, breakaway, stop displacement and triggering repeatability with a dial indicator and dummy load. Measure the coupled controller's worst response and stopping distance on the chosen machine before approval.

title: Twin-indicator spindle tramming bar
engineering: Reversing a 176 mm twin-indicator bar reduces synthetic spindle-tilt inference error from 0.0270° to 0.00163°.
physical_check: Check the paired gauges individually against a reference, compare seating when reinserted, and measure bar flex, surface error and repeatability on a stable flat reference.

title: Adjustable kerf transfer gauge
engineering: Transferring actual stock thickness minus actual kerf cuts worst modeled slot error from 3.36 to 0.10 mm across three blade cases.
physical_check: Measure actual kerf for each blade and substrate, transfer offsets to scrap layout coupons, then compare repeatability and width before applying the gauge to a job.

title: Vertical heat-set insert press
engineering: An 82 mm guide span and 3.21 mm depth-stop setting bring worst modeled center error to 0.173 mm and depth error to 0.09 mm.
physical_check: Measure collar and rod fit, stop compliance, perpendicularity, nose and hold temperature. Verify insert depth, pull-out and eccentricity on the actual polymer and insert series.

title: RC wheel balancing arbor
engineering: Reducing the effective bearing drag radius from 10 mm to 3 mm lowers modeled detection threshold from 1.33 g to 0.44 g at 37 mm radius.
physical_check: Measure unloaded breakaway torque, fit and concentricity on the actual wheels. Apply traceable test masses, then repeat after re-clamping the cones and reversing the wheel.

title: Bicycle wheel dish gauge
engineering: Widening the foot adjustment range and matching pad heights leaves 6 mm of radial travel reserve and 1.72 mm modeled detection of a known dish shim.
physical_check: Measure real rim contact heights and hub offsets, then reverse on a flat reference and shimmed rim to check gauge bias, deflection, repeatability and seating.

title: Bicycle derailleur hanger alignment gauge
engineering: Reducing diametral clearance from 0.32 mm to 0.06 mm limits its modeled projection at the rim to 0.563 mm.
physical_check: Measure threaded adapter fit, seat play, arm deflection and repeatability on an expendable hanger reference with a measured tilt. Check the wheel datum before interpreting indicator readings.

title: Guide-rail angle setting stop
engineering: Spacing rail contacts 170 mm apart reduces modeled layout drift at 600 mm from 2.22 to 1.06 mm.
physical_check: Measure the named rail and contact play, then check layout repeatability at all three detents under equivalent hand loading on a stationary coupon.

title: Fretboard notched straightedge
engineering: A 647.70 mm scale matches all 24 modeled fret centers and leaves 0.895 mm minimum crown clearance and 4.83 mm minimum contact land.
physical_check: Verify actual scale and fret centers at the neck, then measure straightness on a reference, recount contact lands and recheck stress relief and thermal distortion after machining.
